title: Grid Pathfinding

story.briefing: The last stretch before the Core is the collapsed floor itself. Find the shortest walk from the top-left corner to the bottom-right, through open cells only.
story.success: Route found through the rubble. The way to the Core is open.

description: Given a grid of 0 (open) and 1 (blocked), return the fewest steps needed to walk from the top-left cell to the bottom-right cell, moving only up, down, left or right between open cells. Count the number of steps taken, so a 1x1 open grid needs 0. Return -1 if either corner is blocked or no route exists.
hints: Every step costs the same, so the first time you arrive at a cell is necessarily by a shortest route. That is what makes an expanding frontier the right tool.
Check both corners before starting — a blocked start means the answer is -1 immediately, and code that assumes the start is open will happily walk out of it.

Mark the start visited with distance 0 and put it in a queue. Take cells in the order they were added, and for each open unvisited neighbour record one more step and enqueue it. Stop when you reach the far corner.
